name: clock-commitlint
cmd: set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; sha256sum clock-message/COMMIT.txt; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < clock-message/COMMIT.txt
